findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_burofax_draft" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user has approved the final text of a letter to send as a burofax to an address in Spain and has given both postal addresses. The user writes …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "claude" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_spanish_address, get_burofax_status · Public sink: quote_burofax, create_burofax_draft, get_burofax_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_spanish_address, get_burofax_status · Public sink: quote_burofax, create_burofax_draft, get_burofax_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
